artifacts.claimText: Penn’s Center for Excellence in Teaching, Learning and Innovation (CETLI) maintains updated institutional guidance on Penn-licensed AI tools, providing community access to PennChat (with free daily token allotments for FERPA-protected educational records and HIPAA-protected health information via PennKey while on campus or VPN), alongside Anthropic Enterprise (Claude), Articulate AI Assistant, Adobe Express, and Copilot Chat, while mandating that instructors must not require students to enter personal information or intellectual property into unlicensed tools.
artifacts.normalizedValue: Penn provides institutional access to licensed AI tools including PennChat, Anthropic Enterprise, and Copilot Chat for FERPA/HIPAA data, while prohibiting mandatory student entry of personal info or IP into unlicensed tools.
